test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. In a study sponsored by World Health Organisation and carried out by Harvard School of Public Health, the global burden and injury indicated that stress diseases and accidents are going to be the killers in 2020.

B. Road traffic accidents are going to be the third largest killers.

C. These accidents are also an indicator of psycho-social stress in a fast-moving society.

D. The heart disease and depression - both stress diseases - are going to rank first and second in 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is "ADBC."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The given sequence provides a logical and coherent flow of information in the paragraph about the global burden of diseases and injuries in 2020:
 
 
• **Sentence A** introduces the study sponsored by the World Health Organization and carried out by Harvard School of Public Health, indicating that stress diseases and accidents will be significant causes of mortality in 2020.
 
• **Sentence D** follows by specifying that heart disease and depression, both categorized as stress diseases, will be the first and second leading causes of death.
 
• **Sentence B** adds a specific detail about road traffic accidents, highlighting that they will be the third largest killers.
 
• **Sentence C** then connects accidents to psycho-social stress in a fast-moving society, offering an additional insight into the broader implications of these accidents.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct sequence:

A. In a study sponsored by World Health Organisation and carried out by Harvard School of Public Health, the global burden and injury indicated that stress diseases and accidents are going to be the killers in 2020.

D. The heart disease and depression - both stress diseases - are going to rank first and second in 2020.

B. Road traffic accidents are going to be the third largest killers.

C. These accidents are also an indicator of psycho-social stress in a fast-moving society.
